tools.name: search_patterns
tools.description: List tested patterns with their headline result on one market and timeframe. Filter by name, family, direction or verdict, for example: which chart patterns beat chance on forex 4h. Patterns recorded on both breakout sides have no all row and are not listed: read them with get_pattern_stats.

tools.name: get_pattern_stats
tools.description: Full tested results of one pattern: detection rule, trade rules and every market, timeframe and breakout side measured, with confidence intervals, q-values, verdicts, timing quartiles and the page URL to cite.

tools.name: compare_patterns
tools.description: Put 2 to 10 patterns side by side on the same market, timeframe and breakout side.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: How the statistics are computed: principles, the meaning of every field and verdict, and data coverage (assets and date range per market and timeframe).
